findings.failureScenario: No public unit has gate evidence bound to current HEAD. The gate rejects a receipt when its commit differs from HEAD, its package path is dirty, a required host receipt is absent, or its artifact digest is invalid. A release from this snapshot therefore lacks current qualification evidence; stale receipts cannot establish release readiness.
findings.action: From a clean, release-candidate commit, create fresh per-unit evidence with matching version, required host receipts, and sealed artifact digest; package and install each unit before release qualification.
findings.verificationMethod: Compared current HEAD against all 60 local gate evidence commits; zero matched current HEAD. Confirmed the fail-closed checks in live publication-gate source.

findings.failureScenario: The runtime rule requires measured ceiling, CPU, disk activity, runtime exposure, and first-consumer scale evidence, but cargo publication only parses a README section for resident, CPU, and one Measured line. It does not validate a run artifact or those omitted proof fields. Two listed continuous crates, daemon and send, are private and bypass cargo publication entirely, so app adoption can occur without this gate.
findings.action: Make release/adoption qualification require a structured measured receipt with ceiling, CPU, disk, runtime-status, and scale-run fields. Apply it to private app-adopted crates and add continuous owners such as process and models to required membership after owner review.
findings.verificationMethod: Read rule, checker, and cargo publish path; verified all 11 listed READMEs lack the required heading and verified daemon/send set publish = false.

findings.failureScenario: Archive declarations describe intended contents, but no current package archive or fresh install establishes that every public unit resolves independently. Cargo's publication plan checks package contents and registry dry-run, but current review has no executed portability receipt; npm and Swift parity is likewise unqualified.
findings.action: Record fresh package/archive and clean-install receipts for each public unit across required consumer platforms before release readiness is claimed.
findings.verificationMethod: Validated the review's no-pack/no-install boundary against the live cargo publication plan; no execution was run for this lens.
